notes.title: Oik 3 update!
notes.notes:
New achievements have been added to the game. You just need to enter the game to get them. These achievements duplicate the achievements of other games that can not be displayed in the profile.

There were also some bug fixes in the game.

notes.title: TOK HARDCORE Update
notes.notes:
Now the game has a "god mode". You can enable it in the main menu. In the "God mode" from the game, the limitations of rotations and the timer disappear.
Players who complete the game in normal mode will receive an additional 6 achievements. If you have already completed the game according to the old rules, simply start the game and get these achievements automatically.
The spin counter in the main game has been increased by 4 - 12 points, now the player has a "margin for error".

Also in the game were added links to the "creator page on Steam" and Twitter.
Level buttons become animated. 
Fixed minor bugs.


Have a nice game!

notes.title: TOK 2 update
notes.notes:
Hi, bro! I read your reviews and made some changes to the game:

- Earlier in the game there were restrictions on the number of turns. They remained, but the number of turns on each level increased by two. If you keep within the required amount, you will get additional achievements. If you have spent the required number of turns, then they will go to minus but not more than the amount that was given at the beginning of the level.
- In the first level appeared tutorial.
- Turns have been improved.

Also in the game there were additional achievements for the perfect passing game. If you have already completed the game according to the old rules, you only need to start the game and you will get them. No need to go through the game again.


Many thanks to all the people who left the reviews and wrote to me in the mail, you helped me a lot.
